# `aitbc crosschain swaps`

List persisted cross-chain swaps, optionally filtered.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc crosschain swaps [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--user-address` | text | — | no | Filter by user address |
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status |
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Number of swaps to show |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc crosschain swaps
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc crosschain swaps --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
